description: This file contains a test script that defines and executes a series of shell commands to test and demonstrate the behavior of Git hooks and push operations with specific configurations. It involves setting up hook callbacks, performing Git pushes, and verifying the output and state of references.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up a Git hook script for testing purposes.

methods.name: test-tool
methods.description: A utility for outputting verbose information during tests.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats test output and saves expected results for comparison.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output to expected output in tests.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares references in the Git repository to expected references.
